G01.name: Tenant Boundaries
G01.requirement: Strict isolation between 7 simulated ISP tenants; prevent cross-tenant IDOR.
G01.evidence: Verified across test_cross_tenant_isolation_matrix.py (telemetry, incidents, actions, policy).

G02.name: Ingestion
G02.requirement: IPFIX/NetFlow v9 ingestion normalization, schema contracts, timestamp validation.
G02.evidence: 100% contract compliance in test_contracts.py and replay scenarios.

G03.name: Durable Delivery
G03.requirement: SQLite WAL durability, window checkpointing, outbox pattern.
G03.evidence: Verified WAL transactions, online SQLite backups, zero corruption on restore.

G04.name: Learning Privacy
G04.requirement: SecAgg+ secure aggregation, Flower 7-client cohort admission, no plaintext update leaks.
G04.evidence: Verified in test_seven_client_federation.py and federation status endpoints.

G05.name: Differential Privacy Accounting
G05.requirement: DP-SGD with Opacus, Renyi/PRV cumulative epsilon/delta accounting, budget persistence.

G06.name: Model Safety
G06.requirement: Candidate model registry parity, 14-feature contract, network_action_executed = False.
G06.evidence: LightGBM deployable subset verified; sub-millisecond CPU execution, zero code execution on load.

G07.name: Detection Utility
G07.requirement: Hybrid rules FCS-R101..104 + LightGBM + Anomaly isolation, 0 false alarms on normal traffic.
G07.evidence: Normal scenario replay yields 0 false positives; DDoS and Scan triggers verified.

G08.requirement: Human approval required, protected IP allowlists, TTL expiry, rollback, audit journal.
G08.evidence: FirewallSimulator verified; protected targets (DNS, gateway) rejected unconditionally.

G09.name: Reliability & Recovery
G09.requirement: Sub-minute RTO, graceful degradation to rules-only on model corruption.

G10.name: Ledger Governance
G10.requirement: Consortium model promotion governance, RFC 8785 canonical manifests, dual signatures.
G10.evidence: Dual ECDSA P-256 + ML-DSA-65 signatures generated and verified over master release manifest.

G11.name: Supply Chain Security

G12.name: Quantum Research Isolation

G13.name: AUTO Authorization & Safety

G14.evidence: 100% verified across dataset-unit, dataset-security, and reproducibility suites.
